Question Choices: How many dots are in a full ten frame? How many ones are in one ten?
Solution: A full ten frame has two rows of five dots: 5 + 5 = 10. Ten ones also make one ten. Both answers are 10.
right derivation: Count the dots in each row of the frame. | Use 5 dots in the first row and 5 in the second; also count ones in a ten.
wrong derivation: Count the dots in each row of the frame. | Use 4 dots in the first row and 5 in the second; also count ones in a ten.
